Execute JavaScript that returns document.title and verify success with data

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const crawlberg = @import("crawlberg");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try crawlberg.interact("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}", "https://example.com", "[{\"script\":\"document.title\",\"type\":\"executeJs\"}]");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
